text:
maria: Heads-up — after yesterday's ONNX quant bring-up for model-x, eval-runner started spiking shard memory and throttling queues. Seen on canary only so far. :thinking_face:
devon: saw alerts. CI job `eval-runner/scale-e2e` failed with OOM on shard-7 at 10:12 UTC, then backlog grew. Logs show repeated retry churn.
ryan: can you paste the OOM log? wondering if quant changed KV cache size or dtype footprint.
maria: pasted snippet below:
```
2026-03-18T10:12:07Z eval-runner shard=7 worker=3 ERROR OOM: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-18T10:12:08Z eval-dispatcher queue_length=432 retry=1 WARN high latency
2026-03-18T10:12:09Z shard-allocator action=throttle shard=7 reason=mem_pressure
```
ryan: hm. ONNX quant pack uses int8 kernels but we added per-shard precomputed attention caches in bring-up. That could increase host mem and GPU pinning.
devon: also noticed metric drift on evals: compared run before quant to after — decode perplexity up ~3.5% on validation shard. Might be quality regression tied to quant.
ryan: two problems: 1) runtime oom/backpressure; 2) small quality regression. For runtime, quick mitigation: reduce concurrent workers per shard and drop batch_size to 1 for canary. For quality, run small eval-suite with original fp16 vs onnx-int8 to isolate.
maria: will patch canary config: set workers_per_shard=1, batch=1, and enable fallback to fp16 model variant on failures. Deploying now. @ci-bot can you run eval-suite/quick-bleu on the canary after patch? :pray:
ci-bot: queued eval-suite/quick-bleu on canary-model-x (run id: crun-20260318-11). ETA ~8m.
devon: also think we should add a telemetry metric for "kv_cache_bytes_per_shard" and surface it on the eval-runner dashboard so we can see correlation. Right now we only graph queue_length and gpu_mem_used.
ryan: agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to add kv cache gauge + emit tag quant_variant=int8|fp16. Also add a CI gate: if quick-bleu delta > 2% and perplexity delta > 2% fail the onboarding job.
maria: sounds good. action items: (1) canary config change (done), (2) run quick eval (in progress), (3) ryan to add telemetry + CI gate, (4) if regression persists, rollback quant or tune calibration. I'll keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy canary-config update succeeded (deploy id: d-20260318-77). No new alerts so far.
ci-bot: quick-bleu result: bleu_delta=+0.8% (int8 vs fp16), ppl_delta=+2.9% -> QA gate: FAIL (perf regression >2%). See logs: https://ci.internal/runs/crun-20260318-11
maria: thanks — the perf gate failing confirms regression. Ryan, please prioritize the telemetry/CI gate PR and then we'll iterate on quant calibration.
ryan: on it. I'll ping when PR is ready.
maria: thanks team — will open a short postmortem if we need rollback. Keeping this thread as single source for triage. :eyes:
